items.title: 7.3.2 Impacts of the Digital Divide (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Digital divide ke door ras asraat hain: yeh taleem, maeeshat, shehri zindagi, sehat aur digital khwandagi mein maujooda na-barabari gehri aur nayi paida kar sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Digital divide maujooda na-barabari ko kyun barha sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Pehle se pichhre log online taleem, rozgar aur khidmat se mehroom ho kar rasai walon se mazeed peeche reh jate hain.

items: Asraat: taleem, maeeshat, shehri shirakat, sehat, digital khwandagi.
